# Proverbs 20 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 20:4 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Because-of winter the-sluggard does-not-plow; he-asks in-harvest and-there-is-nothing. |
| LOGOS | The sluggard does not plow in the autumn; he will seek at harvest and have nothing. |
| PNEUMA | A lazy person doesn't plow when they should, so when harvest comes, they look around and there's nothing. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| PNEUMA | Using two different sets of weights — one to buy, one to sell — the LORD finds that disgusting. |
